grammar.summary: 本课学习表条件的 but for 与 would have done 虚拟。

points.title: but for 表"要不是"
points.explanation: But for the rapid burial, no fossils would have survived. but for + 名词 = 虚拟条件（含蓄条件句）；主句 would have done 表过去虚拟结果。

examples.en: But for this rapid burial, we would know little about the past.
examples.cn: 要不是这种迅速掩埋，我们对过去将知之甚少。

points.title: 表"极不可能"的 the chances are that
points.explanation: The chances are that... = 很可能……，概率表达替代 will 的武断。

examples.en: The chances are that the remains will be destroyed.
